02-09-1883 is 2 September 1883.  
27 weeks = 27 × 7 = 189 days.  
Plus 5 days = 194 days before.  
1883 is not a leap year (1884 is).  
Count back: September has 30 days, so from Sep 2 back 2 days → Aug 31.  
Remaining 192 days earlier: August has 31 days, July 31, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28 (1883 not leap).  
Back through August: 31 days → Aug 0 means July 31. Then back further:  
July 31 days → July 0 means June 30.  
June 30 days → June 0 means May 31.  
May 31 days → May 0 means April 30.  
April 30 days → April 0 means March 31.  
March 31 days → March 0 means February 28? Actually March 1 back 1 day → Feb 28.  
We have used: 2 (Sep) + 31 (Aug) + 31 (Jul) + 30 (Jun) + 31 (May) + 30 (Apr) + 31 (Mar) + 1 (Feb) = 187 days.  
Need 194 days before, so 7 more days into February: Feb 28 - 7 days = Feb 21.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1883-02-21
